usedFor: A Facebook Lead Ads submission is written into Zoho CRM as a note.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Submitted” in Facebook Lead Ads, then “Create a Note” in Zoho CRM
bestTemplate.why: It puts the submission in a note in the chosen module, so the caller has context.

watchOut: “Create a Note” does not create the lead, so the Zoho CRM record must exist first.
